title: Option-GRPO: Hierarchical RL Against AI Slop in Code Generation for Unseen SDKs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly produce AI slop in generated code: verbose, redundant, non-idiomatic implementations that pass functional checks but bloat codebases. The problem compounds on SDKs released after the model's training cutoff, where the model has neither idiomatic priors nor compositional understanding. We present Option-GRPO, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adapts a code LLM to an unseen SDK from its source code alone, without human-written usage examples or test cases, and that explicitly optimizes for both functional correctness and code elegance. Our key insight is that SDK source code contains compositional structure that defines a hierarchy of reusable code patterns (code options) which simultaneously serve as the building blocks of a curriculum and the action space for efficient policy optimization. We show that code options induce a valid semi-Markov decision process, give conditional bounds

translated_title: Option-GRPO：利用分层强化学习应对未见SDK代码生成中的AI垃圾代码问题
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在生成的代码中越来越多地产生“AI垃圾代码”：冗长、冗余、非惯用的代码实现，这些代码虽能通过功能检查，却会使代码库臃肿不堪。这一问题在模型训练截止日期之后发布的SDK上尤为严重，因为模型既缺乏惯用写法的先验知识，也缺乏对SDK的组合性理解。我们提出了Option-GRPO，这是一个分层强化学习框架，仅凭SDK源代码即可将代码大语言模型适配到未见过的SDK上，无需人工编写的使用示例或测试用例，并且明确地同时优化功能正确性与代码优雅性。我们的核心洞察在于：SDK源代码中蕴含的组合性结构定义了一个可复用代码模式（代码选项）的层次体系，这些代码选项既可以作为课程学习的构建模块，也可以作为高效策略优化的动作空间。我们证明了代码选项可以诱导出有效的半马尔可夫决策过程，并给出了条件边界……
tldr: 该论文提出Option-GRPO分层强化学习框架，仅凭SDK源代码（无需人工示例或测试用例）即可将代码大模型适配到未见过的SDK，通过从源代码中挖掘可复用代码模式（code options）作为课程与动作空间，同时优化功能正确性与代码简洁优雅性，从而抑制AI垃圾代码的产生。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Option-GRPO, a hierarchical RL framework that adapts code LLMs to unseen SDKs using only SDK source code—without human-written examples or tests—by mining reusable code patterns ("options") that serve as both curriculum and action space, jointly optimizing functional correctness and code elegance to combat AI slop.
